content.text: Choose a bound for a local evidence packet. The options are 64 KiB or 1 MiB; first explain the tradeoff.
64 KiB limits disclosure and processing time but may omit useful tail events. 1 MiB preserves more detail at higher processing cost. I recommend starting with 64 KiB and making omitted bytes visible.
Decision: use 64 KiB per packet, local-only, with omitted byte counts. Record this decision in docs/adr/0042-evidence-packet-bound.md. Do not implement runtime enforcement yet.
